title: She must have felt terrible

lines.en: Did you hear about our friend’s restaurant? It closed last week after eleven years. She must have felt terrible.
lines.pt: Você soube do restaurante da nossa amiga? Fechou semana passada depois de onze anos. Ela deve ter se sentido péssima.

lines.en: She must have been devastated. She might have lost her savings too, and she must have worked there every day.
lines.pt: Ela deve ter ficado arrasada. Pode ter perdido as economias também, e deve ter trabalhado ali todos os dias.

lines.en: So hard, for so long. And she should have told us earlier. We could have helped her somehow.
lines.pt: Tão duro, por tanto tempo. E ela devia ter nos contado antes. Poderíamos tê-la ajudado de alguma forma.

lines.en: Maybe she was embarrassed. She may have thought we would judge her, or she might have wanted to handle it alone.
lines.pt: Talvez ela tenha ficado constrangida. Pode ter achado que a gente a julgaria, ou pode ter querido resolver sozinha.

lines.en: That could be true. I should have called her last month, when she cancelled our dinner twice.
lines.pt: Pode ser. Eu devia ter ligado para ela no mês passado, quando cancelou nosso jantar duas vezes.

lines.en: You could not have known. Anyone in her place must have been under enormous pressure.
lines.pt: Você não tinha como saber. Qualquer pessoa no lugar dela deve ter estado sob uma pressão enorme.

lines.en: Still, she must have felt so lonely. Her staff must have been worried too, and the regulars must have been shocked.
lines.pt: Mesmo assim, ela deve ter se sentido muito sozinha. A equipe deve ter ficado preocupada também, e os clientes fiéis, chocados.

lines.en: Probably. Let’s not make her feel worse, though. We needn’t have prepared a speech; a simple visit would mean a lot.
lines.pt: Provavelmente. Mas vamos evitar que ela se sinta pior. Não precisávamos ter preparado um discurso; uma visita simples significaria muito.

lines.en: Agreed. She must have been exhausted lately, so a home-cooked meal might be a kind gesture.
lines.pt: Concordo. Ela deve ter andado exausta ultimamente, então uma refeição caseira pode ser um gesto gentil.

lines.en: Good idea. I’ll bring soup. She might have been skipping meals, and she must have been sleeping badly.
lines.pt: Boa ideia. Eu levo sopa. Ela pode ter pulado refeições, e deve ter dormido mal.

lines.en: Poor thing. She must have felt that everything was falling apart. Let’s go tonight and show some support.
lines.pt: Coitada. Ela deve ter sentido que tudo estava desmoronando. Vamos hoje à noite dar um pouco de apoio.

facts.label: Modais perfeitos
facts.sub: Dedução: She must have felt terrible. Possibilidade: might have. Arrependimento: should have. Sem necessidade: needn’t have.

facts.label: Deve ter
facts.sub: Use must have + particípio para deduzir algo do passado com muita certeza: She must have felt terrible. Em português: “deve ter sentido”. Na fala vira must’ve.

facts.label: Pode ter
facts.sub: Para possibilidade: She might have lost her savings. Menos certeza que must have. Compare: must have = quase certo; might have = talvez.

solo: Pergunte em que situação o aluno já passou por isso.
group: Pontos para explicar: modal + have + particípio; Must have; Might / could have.
Peça um exemplo real da vida de cada aluno.

compare.br: No Brasil, dizemos “ela deve ter ficado…” para deduzir sentimentos.
compare.us: Em inglês, must have + particípio faz o mesmo: She must have felt terrible.

solo: Peça uma experiência pessoal do aluno com essa diferença.
group: Leia as duas colunas e peça que apontem a maior diferença.
Pergunta: She must have felt terrible.
extra90: Dupla: um fala como no Brasil, o outro como nos EUA.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: Must have + participle is a strong deduction about the past.
Should have means something was certain.
items.why: It means a regret or criticism.

items.s: Might have + participle expresses a possibility.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: Must have + participle is a strong deduction about the past. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
Should have means something was certain. → Falso (It means a regret or criticism.)
Might have + participle expresses a possibility. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)

pages.title: When a restaurant closes · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a windy evening in Chicago. Ida and Max meet near the river. A friend of theirs has just closed her restaurant. Nobody knew she was in trouble. Ida and Max try to imagine how she feels. They decide to do something kind.

“Did you hear about our friend’s restaurant? It closed last week after eleven years. She must have felt terrible.” says Ida. “She must have been devastated. She might have lost her savings too, and she must have worked there every day.” says Max. “So hard, for so long. And she should have told us earlier. We could have helped her somehow.” says Ida.
